rationale: The Court is most likely to produce a fractured majority: a lead opinion rejecting a per se “extraterritoriality” theory and treating Proposition 12 as an evenhanded in-state sales condition, with only limited room for Pike balancing at the pleading stage. Separate writings are likely to debate whether Pike is administrable/legitimate (Thomas/Gorsuch) and whether the complaint should proceed to fuller Pike scrutiny (Alito, possibly joined in part by Kavanaugh/Barrett).
